mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism falls below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and confidence rise.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism falls below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the broader economy benefits from increased construction and consumer spending.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the proxy shows sustained increase, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism falls below 0.04 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over two consecutive months signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are negatively impacted.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism falls below 0.02 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in the same month, it signals a robust labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending rise.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k & UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism falls below 0.05 over a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings benefit from increased sales.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the proxy shows sustained increase, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism falls below 0.04 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals an inflationary environment with tight monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded and borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism falls below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings and consumer spending decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
